//: Scopes the main-process source tree to ESM. The root package.json has no `type` (Electron loads dist-electron/**/*.js as CommonJS, and scripts/ are CJS), so without this marker both tsc under `module: NodeNext` and Node's own loader treat every .ts file here as CommonJS and reject the import syntax. This file is not published: electron-builder ships `dist-electron`, not `electron`.
